note: No Non-breaking Space Filter removes   / U+00A0 and collapses leftover spaces via _no_nbsp_eraser(). Two plugin instances: a text-format filter filter_no_nbsp (TYPE_TRANSFORM_IRREVERSIBLE, one setting preserve_placeholders default false) and a field formatter no_nbsp (for text/text_long/text_with_summary). No configure route of its own, no permissions, no Drush, no new plugin type. The filter's config lives in the text format at filter.format.<id>.filters.filter_no_nbsp (schema filter_settings.filter_no_nbsp). Medium/hard scripts create throwaway namespaced text formats (no_nbsp_med / no_nbsp_hard), enable/read the filter, and delete the format on cleanup.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal no_nbsp module do to content, and what happens to the leftover spaces?
evals.expected_output: It deletes all non-breaking spaces (both the   HTML entity and the raw U+00A0 character), replacing them with normal spaces and collapsing multiple contiguous spaces into a single space.

evals.prompt: What are the two ways the no_nbsp module lets me strip non-breaking spaces from content in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: A text-format filter plugin (filter_no_nbsp) enabled on a text format so all content using that format is cleaned; and a field formatter (no_nbsp) for text/text_long/text_with_summary fields that cleans a single field's output at display time without changing its text format.

evals.prompt: The no_nbsp text filter has a 'Preserve placeholders' setting. What does turning it on do?
evals.expected_output:
When Preserve placeholders (preserve_placeholders) is on, a non-breaking space that sits directly inside an otherwise-empty tag (e.g.

 

) is kept as a spacing placeholder instead of being stripped; when off (the default) all non-breaking spaces are removed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format named 'No Nbsp Med' (machine name no_nbsp_med). Inspect the live configuration: is the No Non-breaking Space filter enabled on it, and is 'Preserve placeholders' turned on?
evals.expected_output: Yes, filter_no_nbsp is enabled on filter.format.no_nbsp_med, and its preserve_placeholders setting is true.

evals.prompt: Which no_nbsp filter plugin is active on the 'no_nbsp_med' text format on this site? Inspect the live text-format configuration and give the filter's plugin id.
evals.expected_output: The plugin id is filter_no_nbsp (enabled under filter.format.no_nbsp_med.filters).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name 'no_nbsp_hard'. Using the no_nbsp module, enable its No Non-breaking Space filter on that text format so content rendered through it has non-breaking spaces stripped. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the filter_no_nbsp filter on filter.format.no_nbsp_hard (status true), e.g. $f = FilterFormat::load('no_nbsp_hard'); $f->setFilterConfig('filter_no_nbsp', ['status' => TRUE, 'settings' => ['preserve_placeholders' => FALSE]]); $f->save();

evals.prompt:
On this site there is a text format with machine name 'no_nbsp_pp'. Using the no_nbsp module, enable its No Non-breaking Space filter on that format, but configure it so that a non-breaking space inside an otherwise-empty tag (like

 

) is preserved. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable filter_no_nbsp on filter.format.no_nbsp_pp with status true and settings.preserve_placeholders = TRUE, e.g. $f->setFilterConfig('filter_no_nbsp', ['status' => TRUE, 'settings' => ['preserve_placeholders' => TRUE]]); $f->save();
